mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 0 AS menu_idx, -1 AS parent_menu_idx, '' AS menu_url, '' AS menu_url_param, '최상위' AS menu_name, 0 AS print_seq, 0 AS manage_idx, '' AS board_category1, 'ROOT' AS menu_type, 1 AS load_on_demand, '' AS menu_img FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT menu_idx, parent_menu_idx, CASE menu_type WHEN 'PROGRAM' THEN (SELECT link_url FROM WB_MODULE_MNGT WHERE module_idx = manage_idx) ELSE MENU_TYPE END AS menu_url, menu_url_param, menu_name, print_seq, manage_idx, board_category1, menu_type, CASE WHEN menu_type = 'FOLDER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS load_on_demand, (SELECT menu_img FROM CMS_MENU WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND menu_idx = a.group_idx) AS menu_img FROM CMS_MENU a WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} ) CONNECT BY PRIOR menu_idx = parent_menu_idx START WITH parent_menu_idx = -1 ORDER SIBLINGS BY print_seq

SELECT LEVEL AS menu_level, A.* FROM ( SELECT homepage_id, menu_idx, parent_menu_idx, CASE menu_type WHEN 'PROGRAM' THEN (SELECT link_url FROM WB_MODULE_MNGT WHERE module_idx = manage_idx) ELSE menu_type END AS menu_url, menu_url_param, menu_name, print_seq, menu_type, group_idx, manage_idx, link_url, view_yn, mobile_view_yn, menu_top_icon, board_category1, CASE WHEN menu_type = 'FOLDER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS load_on_demand, (SELECT menu_img FROM CMS_MENU WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND menu_idx = a.group_idx) AS menu_img FROM CMS_MENU a WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND use_yn = 'Y' AND (view_yn != 'N' OR mobile_view_yn != 'N') ) A CONNECT BY PRIOR menu_idx = parent_menu_idx START WITH parent_menu_idx = 0 ORDER SIBLINGS BY print_seq

SELECT LEVEL AS menu_level, A.* FROM ( SELECT homepage_id, menu_idx, parent_menu_idx, CASE menu_type WHEN 'PROGRAM' THEN (SELECT link_url FROM wb_module_mngt WHERE module_idx = manage_idx) ELSE menu_type END AS menu_url, menu_url_param, menu_name, print_seq, menu_type, manage_idx, link_url, view_yn, menu_left_icon, board_category1, (SELECT menu_img FROM CMS_MENU WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND menu_idx = a.group_idx) AS menu_img FROM CMS_MENU a WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND use_yn = 'Y' AND group_idx = #{group_idx} ) A CONNECT BY PRIOR menu_idx = parent_menu_idx START WITH parent_menu_idx = 0 ORDER SIBLINGS BY print_seq ASC

SELECT LEVEL AS MENU_LEVEL, A.*, decode(A.menu_type, 'PROGRAM', (SELECT module_name FROM WB_MODULE_MNGT B WHERE module_type = 'SITE' and A.manage_idx = b.module_idx AND A.menu_type = 'PROGRAM'), 'BOARD', (SELECT board_name FROM CMS_BOARD_MANAGE B WHERE A.manage_idx = B.manage_idx AND A.homepage_id = B.homepage_id), 'LINK', '내부링크', 'LINK_OUTER', '외부링크', a.menu_type) AS moduleName FROM ( SELECT '' AS HOMEPAGE_ID, 0 AS MENU_IDX, -1 AS PARENT_MENU_IDX, '' AS MENU_URL, '' AS MENU_URL_PARAM, '최상위' AS MENU_NAME, 0 AS PRINT_SEQ, 0 AS MANAGE_IDX, '' AS BOARD_CATEGORY1, 'ROOT' AS MENU_TYPE, 1 AS LOAD_ON_DEMAND, '' AS MENU_IMG, '' AS auth_group_id FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT HOMEPAGE_ID, MENU_IDX, PARENT_MENU_IDX, CASE MENU_TYPE WHEN 'PROGRAM' THEN (SELECT LINK_URL FROM WB_MODULE_MNGT WHERE MODULE_IDX = MANAGE_IDX) ELSE MENU_TYPE END AS MENU_URL, MENU_URL_PARAM, MENU_NAME, PRINT_SEQ, MANAGE_IDX, BOARD_CATEGORY1, MENU_TYPE, CASE WHEN MENU_TYPE = 'FOLDER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS LOAD_ON_DEMAND, (SELECT MENU_IMG FROM CMS_MENU WHERE HOMEPAGE_ID = #{homepage_id} AND MENU_IDX = a.GROUP_IDX) AS MENU_IMG, CASE MENU_TYPE WHEN 'BOARD' THEN 'B0001' ELSE b.auth_group_id END AS auth_group_id FROM CMS_MENU a, WB_MODULE_MNGT b WHERE HOMEPAGE_ID = #{homepage_id} AND a.use_yn = 'Y'
AND a.manage_idx = b.module_idx(+) AND b.module_type(+) = 'SITE' ) A CONNECT BY PRIOR MENU_IDX = PARENT_MENU_IDX START WITH PARENT_MENU_IDX = -1 ORDER SIBLINGS BY PRINT_SEQ
mapper.update: UPDATE CMS_MENU A SET a.menu_full_path_name = ( SELECT LTRIM(SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(MENU_NAME,' > '),' >') AS menu_name FROM ( SELECT menu_idx, menu_name, parent_menu_idx, print_seq FROM CMS_MENU a WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} ) b WHERE b.menu_idx = a.menu_idx CONNECT BY PRIOR menu_idx = parent_menu_idx START WITH parent_menu_idx = 0 ) WHERE a.homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
